Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250402. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and structures. Filter rows where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
